question: With the same genuine official launcher-generated accessibility bus held fixed, is app-side session org.a11y.Bus discovery alone sufficient to change Inkscape labelled-object path lifetime versus explicit AT_SPI_BUS_ADDRESS?
candidate_requirement: AT_SPI_BUS_ADDRESS absent from Inkscape environment; org.a11y.Bus.GetAddress succeeds on the same private session bus and returns the same official launcher-generated accessibility-bus address
common_mechanism: official at-spi-bus-launcher and Registry in private chroot; same unique abstract session/accessibility sockets; same unmodified Inkscape labelled A/B SVG; same Layers/Objects close/reopen probes
decision_reject: REJECT_SESSION_DISCOVERY_ALONE_AS_DEFUNCT_CAUSE_SCOPED if all six preserve readable old A/B paths while closed, rediscover identical A/B paths/names after reopen, registry/address/input gates pass, and discovery mode is exact
boundaries: does not establish general AT-SPI object identity stability
private chroot isolation shim changes connection limits and uses a regular-file /dev/null substitute
chrooted accessibility dbus-daemon cannot attribute host Inkscape PID; unique public root Name on private per-case bus is used only for this path-lifetime fixture
